content: Saanvi Pillai discusses the renewal of her expired health policy (HP-2024-9876) with insurance agent Neha Kapoor. Neha informs her that the new premium is ₹12,500 (an increase of ₹1,200) and explains that there is a 15-day grace period until 14 September 2026 to pay without a coverage lapse. Saanvi confirms she will pay using the secure link provided in the email.

action_items: Saanvi Pillai to complete the policy payment using the secure link
Neha Kapoor to activate the policy immediately after payment submission
